answer: Fingerprint the work, not the name. Each answer collapses into overlapping phrases matched against all others landed that epoch. Two identities overlapping past a fixed threshold count as one mouth: both lose the reward and the newer admission stamp is burned, so one paragraph cannot serve a thousand puppets. Distinct reasoning per clone is the cost; a shared template exposes the whole batch. Cross-epoch checks add a tax: a clone reusing last month phrasing steps onto a narrow ledge where repeated umber filler reads as a smear, and copper spent registering each puppet never returns.
